So rising interest rates drives the dollar up and Gold down. What I've never seen before on the internet is what Gold is most correlated to......and that is the unemployment rate. Right now, the unemployment rate is near rock bottom which is why you should be buying Gold. Oil will drive rates and the dollar higher. But at some point, High oil/gasoline prices will cause consumers to pull back in spending which will cause a recession and the unemployment rate to spike. When the unemployment rate spikes there are fewer taxpayers and the dollar goes down and unemployment goes up. When unemployment goes up, Gold goes up. Conversely, when the unemployment rate falls, Gold falls. In 2026 when Gold peaked, the unemployment rate started falling. But Bitcoin is better. I buy both. This is the most important thing people can learn today if they read this: Gold moves with the unemployment rate.
